notes.title: [Important Notice] Pomegranate Housing Complex Release Date Postponement
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for your continued support. We have an important announcement to make.[/p][p]The release date, originally scheduled for October 31st, will be [b]postponed to sometime in December[/b].[/p][p]We sincerely apologize to everyone who has added the game to their wishlist and those who have played the demo version.[/p][p][/p][h3]Reason for Postponement [/h3][p]During development, we have experienced significant delays in text and visual asset creation, resulting in overall progress falling short of our expectations.[/p][p]Rather than prioritizing the original deadline and compromising on quality, we have decided that extending the development period is necessary to deliver a better product to you.[/p][p][/p][h3]Current Development Status[/h3][list][*][p]Core Systems: 90%[/p][/*][*][p]Backgrounds: 90%[/p][/*][*][p]Character Art: 80%[/p][/*][*][p]CG Illustrations: 15%[/p][/*][*][p]Text: 30% (Plot is nearly complete)[/p][/*][*][p]Implementation: 20%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overall Progress: 50%[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Through this postponement, we are committed to developing a more satisfying work that meets our standards.[/p][p]We will continue to provide progress updates as development continues. Please wait a little longer until completion.[/p]

notes.title: "Pomegranate Housing Complex" Monthly Development Report [August 1st, 2025]
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for your continued support. July was completely dedicated to plot development![/p][p][/p][h2]Overall Progress[/h2][list][*][p][b]Plot[/b]: 90%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scenario[/b]: 10%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics[/b]: 16%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Implementation[/b]: 5%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Total Progress[/b]: 10%[/p][/*][*][p][b]August Target[/b]: 65%[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]About the Plot[/h2][p]The plot is 90% complete - nearly finished! [/p][p]As I worked on it, the branching paths and endings kept multiplying, resulting in a much larger volume than originally anticipated. [/p][p]We're planning approximately 20 hours of gameplay for those who collect all events.[/p][p][/p][h2]About Asset Creation[/h2][p]After organizing the graphic assets, I discovered we need about 300 pieces...! [/p][p]Currently at 16% progress, but I'm revising the schedule to push through intensively this month.[/p][p][/p][h2]About the Release Date[/h2][p]If overall progress is below 60% as of September 1st, there's a possibility we'll delay the release date. When that happens, we'll announce it on Steam, X, and our official website. Since this is a solo development project, the schedule tends to be fluid - my apologies for that.[/p][p][/p][h2]About the Price Change[/h2][p]Originally planned at 980 yen, but due to the significant increase in volume, we're changing it to [b]1,480 yen[/b].[/p][p]This also helps differentiate it from casual games and ensures we deliver a substantial experience.[/p][p][/p][h2]Closing[/h2][p]I've managed to write a really solid plot, so now it's just a matter of getting the work done![/p][p]I'll do my absolute best and adjust the schedule as needed, so I'd appreciate your warm support as you watch over the project.[/p][p]Thank you very much![/p]

notes.title: Pomegranate housing complex Development Monthly Report [July 1st, 2025]
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, this is Kizinago. This month, I mainly focused on system cleanup, PV production, and promoting the crowdfunding campaign.[/p][p][/p][h2]Crowdfunding Campaign Promotion[/h2][p]Thanks to everyone's support, the campaign has successfully concluded.[/p][p]The achievement rate reached an incredible [b]238%![/b][/p][p]Thank you so much from the bottom of my heart. I will continue working hard on the development.[/p][p][/p][h2]System Organization[/h2][p]With help from an assistant, I managed to implement GitHub. I also organized all the variable names and image paths that I had been managing haphazardly until now. While it was tedious work, I expect the development efficiency to improve dramatically going forward. Although I regret not doing this sooner, having solidified the foundation gives me peace of mind to focus on my work.[/p][p][/p][h2]Concept PV in Production[/h2][p]I'm currently working on a concept PV for "Zakuro Danchi." Since it will include not only game footage but also collage videos, I plan to release it on YouTube rather than Steam. I'm aiming to post it by the 12th of this month, but... I wonder if I'll make the deadline. I want to create a video that conveys the atmosphere of the work more deeply.[/p][p][/p][h2]Ongoing Scenario Organization[/h2][p]I'm using mind maps and whiteboards to review the scenario structure. Progress is still only about 20%, but I'm working hard to get it into shape by mid-July. When organizing the scenario alone, my perspective tends to become narrow, so I've realized once again how important it is to visualize and get a bird's-eye view.[/p][p][/p][p]We're still far from completion, but I feel like we're steadily moving forward. I appreciate your continued support.[/p]

notes.title: "Pomegranate Housing Complex" Monthly Report [June 9, 2025]
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for your continued support.[/p][p]A lot really happened last month.[/p][p]I will give you a brief report as it will be long.[/p][h2]Trial version released[/h2][p]We released the trial version on May 24.[/p][p]I am glad that we managed to release it at ......, although it was later than planned because I had forgotten about the review process.[/p][p]We also uploaded a revised version Ver. 1.02 on June 6.[/p][p]It is good to release a trial version because we can get a lot of feedback.    [/p][p]I am very touched that so many people have played the game.  Thank you so much.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577571/c9ad1b1aa0bad4f424593070810acf970497dffd.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]We participated in DREAMSCAPE#3[/h2][p]On May 24, we exhibited at the offline event “DREAMSCAPE#3 (Novell Limited Indie Game Exhibition)” in Tokyo.[/p][p]We had a lot of people come to play and it was a very productive day.[/p][p]We are planning to exhibit at Tokyo Game Dungeon 10 in November.[/p][p]We will be exhibiting after the release of the full version of the game... so we will do our best to make it.   [/p][h2]We have achieved 100% crowdfunding![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577571/74322cbfc7222111886fb0f372bfec88b8de9763.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you so much for your support.[/p][p]We are now aiming for 200%.[/p][p]If we reach our goal, we plan to order and sell the regular edition of the setting material book as a paper book.[/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p][p]CAMPFIRE crowdfunding site[/p][h2]Production Progress[/h2][h3]PV production in progress[/h3][p]We are in the process of collecting and processing materials and learning how to use tools.[/p][p]I'm having a hard time collecting materials. But it's fun.[/p][h3]Production of the product version is in progress[/h3][p]I'm preparing the system. I'm also organizing the scenario.[/p][p]I was burnt out and laid back until last week, so I'm going to start working on it in earnest from this week. [/p][h2]Steam Next festival starts tomorrow![/h2][p]This is my first Steam event, so I'm not sure how I'm going to do it, but I hope you'll enjoy it![/p][p]Since it's been two weeks since the release of the demo version, here are some tips for playing the demo version.[/p][h3]Tips for the trial version[/h3][p][spoiler]Calls to the management company change every hour.[/spoiler][/p][p][spoiler]There are 4 levels of psychic disturbance (when you break the rules).[/spoiler][/p][p][spoiler]If you keep patrolling after 8pm...[/spoiler][/p][h2]Conclusion[/h2][p]Thank you for reading this far. We will continue to do our best![/p][p][/p][p]Translated with DeepL.com (free version)[/p]

notes.title: Announcement of PHC Demo Version & Crowdfunding [May 17, 2025]
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support.

This time, I would like to announce the trial version of "Pomegranate housing complex" and the crowdfunding of this work.

There are a lot of events next week, so I will do my best.

[h2]About the Pomegranate housing complex demo version[/h2]

[h3]Scheduled release date[/h3]

[b]Tuesday, May 21, 2025[/b]

It is scheduled to be submitted for review on the 19th.
If it does not go well, it will be postponed.

As this is my first attempt and a personal production and sale, I think there will be many shortcomings, but I would appreciate your understanding. .

[h3]Distribution site[/h3]
[list]
[*] Steam
[*] itch.io
[*] BOOTH
[/list]

Currently, the trial version is scheduled to be distributed on the day [b]Windows only[/b].
This is because the author does not own a Mac due to his working environment... I'm sorry.

However, I'm hoping to release it on Mac as well, so I'd appreciate it if you could wait.

If it's difficult, I'm also considering releasing it on a browser version.

[h3]In-game specifications[/h3]

[list]

[*] Time: 30 seconds = 1 hour

[*] Surveillance area: up to 2nd floor

[*] Patrol area: up to 2nd floor

[*] Phone calls: 1 type (however, the conversation content changes depending on the conditions)

[*] Spiritual disturbance level: 3 levels

[*] Ending branch: 3 types (quite simple)

[/list]

Currently, volunteers are test-playing the provisional data.

Thankfully, there don't seem to be any fatal bugs... so if all goes well, it looks like it will only require minor corrections.

There are lots of gimmicks built in, so you might discover a lot of things if you play it a few times.

We look forward to seeing you all play it!

[h2]About Pomegranate housing complex Crowdfunding[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577571/0b36f65de51bdd9c0cf7ba4271f774374bf56608.png[/img]

Although it will be very short notice, we will be releasing a crowdfunding page on CAMPFIRE.

[h3]Crowdfunding release date[/h3]

[b]Saturday, May 24, 2025[/b]

[h3]Purpose of doing crowdfunding[/h3]

Support for the production of the finished product version of "Pomegranate housing complex"

[h3]Target amount[/h3]

300,000 yen

[h3]Reason for doing crowdfunding[/h3]

Honestly, I'm very sorry...
I'm currently working part-time while developing games, but the physical and mental burden is piling up, and I'm in a position where I need to reconsider the way I work.

However, I feel very attached to "Pomegranate housing complex" so I absolutely want to complete it.

I decided to do crowdfunding so that I can have the time and environment to concentrate on creating, even if just a little.

(Although it's a hidden theme, I also hope that it will help with localization into various languages.)

I will provide more details at a later date, so please look forward to it.

We will also be exhibiting at an offline event in Tokyo on the 24th, so if you're in the area, please come and see us.
